short_description: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler with 9 unique races, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique dungeons, a classless skill system, and extensive guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!
